# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 88 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49-50 | Coptic

---

## Saying 88

Jesus said: "Messengers and prophets will come to you and hand over what is rightfully yours. For your part, give them what you have, and ask yourselves: 'When will the day come that they arrive and claim what belongs to them?'"

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Hand over" — the transfer of property/gifts is made concrete
- "What is rightfully yours" — the legal ownership dimension
- "Claim what belongs to them" — the eschatological claiming of the divine portion
